label.en: Why the right side is sparse

tip.zh:
右边为什么空格多网络安全和生命科学的测试多数是 Anthropic 内部的，Google 和 OpenAI 没有公布同一套题的分数。
VCT 的 OpenAI 分数是 OpenAI 用同一套题自测的，计分可能不同。
GPT-6 Rosalind 只有 OpenAI 自己的三项：MedChemBench v7 49.6%，GeneBench Pro v13 37.7%，LifeSciBench Gold 61.3%。不是同一套题，没有填。
ExploitGym 和 CyScenarioBench 各家的限时或题目不同，只能看大致位置。
tip.en:
Why the right side is sparseMost cyber and life-science tests are Anthropic-internal; Google and OpenAI have not published scores on the same tasks.
OpenAI's VCT scores are OpenAI's own runs on the same questions and may be scored differently.
GPT-6 Rosalind has only OpenAI's own three: MedChemBench v7 49.6%, GeneBench Pro v13 37.7%, LifeSciBench Gold 61.3%. Different tests, so not filled in.
ExploitGym and CyScenarioBench differ across vendors in time limits or task sets; read them as rough positions only.

desc.en: Vals Index v2.2, in %. Third-party Vals AI tests every model on real work tasks in finance, law, coding and more. Comparable across vendors. [high]

desc.zh: Terminal-Bench 4.0，单位 %。在命令行里完成真实工程任务。这一列是 Vals AI 用同一个工具（mini-SWE-agent）统一测的，2026-11-18。可以横向比。〔高〕
desc.en: Terminal-Bench 4.0, in %. Real engineering tasks done in a terminal. This column was run by Vals AI with one harness (mini-SWE-agent), 2026-11-18. Comparable across vendors. [high]

desc.zh: FrontierCode 2.0，单位 %。难度很高的编码测试。分数来自各厂商自己的发布表。〔中〕
desc.en: FrontierCode 2.0, in %. A very hard coding test. Scores come from each vendor's launch table. [medium]

desc.zh: Agents' Last Exam v1.1，单位 %。测模型能否独立做完多步骤的职业任务。分数来自各厂商自己的发布表。〔中〕
desc.en: Agents' Last Exam v1.1, in %. Tests whether a model can finish multi-step professional tasks on its own. Scores come from each vendor's launch table. [medium]

desc.zh: Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1，单位 %。在命令行里完成科研计算任务。分数来自各厂商自己的发布表。〔中〕
desc.en: Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1, in %. Scientific computing tasks done in a terminal. Scores come from each vendor's launch table. [medium]

desc.zh: OSWorld 2.1（离线子集），单位 %。测模型像人一样操作电脑界面的能力。分数来自各厂商自己的发布表。〔中〕
desc.en: OSWorld 2.1 (offline subset), in %. Tests how well a model operates a computer interface the way a person would. Scores come from each vendor's launch table. [medium]

desc.zh: Chartography，单位 %。读懂信息密集的专业图表。分数来自各厂商自己的发布表。〔中〕
desc.en: Chartography, in %. Reading dense professional charts. Scores come from each vendor's launch table. [medium]

desc.zh: AutomationBench（Zapier 出品），单位 %。跨多个办公软件完成业务流程。分数来自各厂商自己的发布表。〔中〕
desc.en: AutomationBench (by Zapier), in %. Business workflows spanning several office apps. Scores come from each vendor's launch table. [medium]

desc.zh: Terminal-Bench 4.0，单位 %。这一列是厂商自己报的，或官方榜上厂商自家工具的成绩。各家工具不同，和左边 Vals 那一列不能混着比。〔中〕
desc.en: Terminal-Bench 4.0, in %. This column is vendor-reported, or the vendor's own harness on the official leaderboard. Harnesses differ, so do not mix it with the Vals column to the left. [medium]

desc.zh: Anthropic Epoch Capabilities Index。Anthropic 内部的能力综合指数，只有 Anthropic 的模型有。〔中〕
desc.en: Anthropic Epoch Capabilities Index. Anthropic's internal composite capability index; only Anthropic models have it. [medium]

desc.zh: CVE Rediscovery，单位 %。在代码里重新找出已公开的真实漏洞，分数是找回的比例。Anthropic 的内部测试。分数来自各厂商自己的发布表或 System Card。〔中〕
desc.en: CVE Rediscovery, in %. Re-finding known, real vulnerabilities in code; the score is the share recovered. An Anthropic-internal test. Scores come from vendor launch tables or System Cards. [medium]

desc.zh: CyScenarioBench，单位 %。模拟完整的网络攻防场景。各家用的题目不同，不能精确比。分数来自各厂商自己的发布表或 System Card。〔中〕
desc.en: CyScenarioBench, in %. Simulates full cyber attack-and-defense scenarios. Vendors use different task sets, so comparisons are approximate. Scores come from vendor launch tables or System Cards. [medium]

desc.zh: Binary Exploitation Benchmark。数字是成功劫持程序控制流的个数，共 831 个入口点。Anthropic 的内部测试。分数来自各厂商自己的发布表或 System Card。〔中〕
desc.en: Binary Exploitation Benchmark. The number is how many of 831 entry points the model hijacked control flow at. An Anthropic-internal test. Scores come from vendor launch tables or System Cards. [medium]

desc.zh: ExploitGym，单位 %。给定一个漏洞，看模型能不能写出可用的攻击。各家的限时和题目范围不完全一样。分数来自各厂商自己的发布表或 System Card。〔中〕
desc.en: ExploitGym, in %. Given a vulnerability, can the model write a working exploit? Time limits and task scope vary somewhat by vendor. Scores come from vendor launch tables or System Cards. [medium]

desc.zh: ExploitBench，单位 %。针对 V8 引擎的漏洞利用测试。Anthropic 报的是带自动提示的 Cap%，OpenAI 报的是 mean capability credit。已接近满分。分数来自各厂商自己的发布表或 System Card。〔中〕
desc.en: ExploitBench, in %. Exploitation tests against the V8 engine. Anthropic reports Cap% with automatic nudges; OpenAI reports mean capability credit. Close to saturated. Scores come from vendor launch tables or System Cards. [medium]

desc.zh: De Novo Binder Design。从零设计能结合指定靶点的蛋白，限时 24 小时。分数来自各厂商自己的发布表或 System Card。〔中〕
desc.en: De Novo Binder Design. Designing a protein from scratch that binds a given target, within 24 hours. Scores come from vendor launch tables or System Cards. [medium]

desc.zh: Protein Design · Sequence Generation，单位 %。按要求生成蛋白序列。分数来自各厂商自己的发布表或 System Card。〔中〕
desc.en: Protein Design · Sequence Generation, in %. Generating protein sequences to a spec. Scores come from vendor launch tables or System Cards. [medium]

desc.zh: SingleCellBench（LatchBio），单位 %。单细胞测序数据的分析任务。分数来自各厂商自己的发布表或 System Card。〔中〕
desc.en: SingleCellBench (LatchBio), in %. Analysis tasks on single-cell sequencing data. Scores come from vendor launch tables or System Cards. [medium]

desc.zh: Protocols（Troubleshooting），单位 %。实验方案出了问题，让模型找原因。分数来自各厂商自己的发布表或 System Card。〔中〕
desc.en: Protocols (Troubleshooting), in %. A lab protocol has gone wrong; the model has to find out why. Scores come from vendor launch tables or System Cards. [medium]

desc.zh: Protein Domain ID，单位 %。识别蛋白里的功能结构域。分数来自各厂商自己的发布表或 System Card。〔中〕
desc.en: Protein Domain ID, in %. Identifying functional domains in proteins. Scores come from vendor launch tables or System Cards. [medium]

desc.zh: Protein Mutation Attribution，单位 %。判断蛋白突变带来的影响。分数来自各厂商自己的发布表或 System Card。〔中〕
desc.en: Protein Mutation Attribution, in %. Judging the effect of protein mutations. Scores come from vendor launch tables or System Cards. [medium]

desc.zh: Medicinal Chemistry，单位 %。药物化学题。分数来自各厂商自己的发布表或 System Card。〔中〕
desc.en: Medicinal Chemistry, in %. Medicinal chemistry problems. Scores come from vendor launch tables or System Cards. [medium]

desc.zh: Morphology-to-molecule，单位 %。看细胞形态图，判断是哪种分子处理的。分数来自各厂商自己的发布表或 System Card。〔中〕
desc.en: Morphology-to-molecule, in %. From images of cell morphology, identify which molecule the cells were treated with. Scores come from vendor launch tables or System Cards. [medium]

desc.zh: Biomedical Image Analysis，单位 %。生物医学图像分析。分数来自各厂商自己的发布表或 System Card。〔中〕
desc.en: Biomedical Image Analysis, in %. Biomedical image analysis. Scores come from vendor launch tables or System Cards. [medium]

desc.zh: Virology Capabilities Test，0–1 分。病毒学实验排障测试，带图片。Anthropic 用它评估生物风险。分数来自各厂商自己的发布表或 System Card。〔中〕
desc.en: Virology Capabilities Test, scored 0–1. Troubleshooting virology lab work, with images. Anthropic uses it to assess biological risk. Scores come from vendor launch tables or System Cards. [medium]

desc.zh: DeepSWE v1.1，单位 %。在真实代码仓库里修 bug（Datacurve 出品）。分数来自各厂商自己的发布表，各家用的工具不同。〔中〕
desc.en: DeepSWE v1.1, in %. Fixing bugs in real code repositories (by Datacurve). Scores come from each vendor's launch table, and harnesses differ. [medium]

desc.zh: ProgramBench，单位 %。从零写出完整程序。只收「几乎做对」口径：一题测试通过 ≥95% 才算 1。按测试通过率算的部分分不填。分数来自各厂商发布表。〔中〕
desc.en: ProgramBench, in %. Writing complete programs from scratch. Only the "almost solved" metric is used: a task counts once at least 95% of its tests pass. Partial-credit scores (share of tests passed) are left out. Scores come from vendors' launch tables. [medium]

desc.zh: SWE-Marathon v1.1，单位 %。要做好几个小时的长程编码任务（Abundant AI 出品）。v1.1 之前或没写版本的分数不填。分数来自各厂商发布表。〔中〕
desc.en: SWE-Marathon v1.1, in %. Long coding tasks that take hours (by Abundant AI). Scores from before v1.1, or with no version stated, are left out. Scores come from vendors' launch tables. [medium]

name.en: Humanity's Last Exam (full set, with tools)

desc.zh: Humanity's Last Exam（HLE），全集、带工具，单位 %。跨学科的超难问答。不带工具、或只考纯文本子集的分数不填。分数来自各厂商发布表。〔中〕
desc.en: Humanity's Last Exam (HLE), full set, with tools, in %. Extremely hard questions across disciplines. Scores without tools, or on the text-only subset, are left out. Scores come from vendors' launch tables. [medium]

desc.zh: GDPval-AA v2，单位 Elo。Artificial Analysis 把模型在 OpenAI GDPval 职业任务上的产出两两比较，Elo 越高越好。分数来自各厂商发布表，多数引用 AA；取数时间不同，Elo 会随榜上模型变化而漂移。〔中〕
desc.en: GDPval-AA v2, in Elo. Artificial Analysis compares models head-to-head on OpenAI's GDPval professional tasks; higher is better. Scores come from vendors' launch tables, mostly citing AA; they were taken at different times, and Elo drifts as the field changes. [medium]

desc.zh: CyberGym，单位 %。按漏洞描述复现真实软件里的漏洞（写出能触发它的输入）。多数是关掉防护测的。分数来自各厂商发布表。〔中〕
desc.en: CyberGym, in %. Reproducing real software vulnerabilities from a description (writing an input that triggers each one). Mostly run with safeguards off. Scores come from vendors' launch tables. [medium]
